primary_antecedent.receiving_contribution: Independent local reflection estimate with the original Banach norm, one fixed scalar source test and one fixed scalar observation test, retaining full cutoff commutators and residual source families.

source_correspondence: H0–H1 state the actual compact scalar family, whole-input product-cone requirement, common observed graph and order-independent geometric margins. The conclusion retains the original Banach norm and two fixed scalar tests.

M0 proves both mixed products on a bounded compressed band, with finite Taylor remainders, separated-frequency integration, proper errors and resolved side-face flatness. A tangential residual alone is not called a full residual.

M1 uses the actual logarithmic unitary map and complete left symbols. Right tangential Fourier multiplication is exact and proves the mixed-to-L2 estimate without identifying mixed and ordinary spaces.

R0 constructs a fixed full cutoff with the prescribed identity region and exact zero-Dirichlet action. R1 uses a proper tangential inverse of an even differential power, then ABR on the negative-order and residual outputs, to control the actual first normal derivative of Hu.
C0 retains the entire ratio-kernel commutator, including Theta-squared and the first-normal-input term. Scalar principal cancellation and the one-order Theta difference give the correct error orders.

C1 verifies the full tested-error support in the elliptic transition band, with normal base derivatives outside the probing interval and all proper residuals retained. The collar is fixed before target regularity.

C2 moves the input normal derivative outside an actual regularized output and applies the elliptic H2 estimate before scalar domination. Every source-family input remains in the common product patch. No ordinary normal forcing derivative is required.

A0 applies the actual reflection theorem to Hu, with its real coarse graph and its true source. The boundary term is exactly zero. The single fixed observation is A2,t H, with full microsupport in the observed interior cone.

A1 recovers each requested target by full boundary and tangential parametrices, the mixed norm bound and every residual source tree. A2 combines precisely those finite families using exact scalar Fourier domination.

A3 proves injective tested-graph completion by flat transposed tests. It keeps graph density, global multipatch assembly and the remaining propagation regimes separate from this proved local estimate.

Three complete solutions verify both coarse exponents, a full normal commutator and power test, and exact characteristic/transition separation. Twenty-three exact algebraic checks support the analytic proof.
The misplaced identity-band label was corrected and the three changed captures re-inspected.
The proof map identifies the exact earlier programme prerequisites. Linked human components retain their authorship and licence notices.
